correctness.rationale: For m>=n word lengths, palindrome uv forces u=rev(v)t with palindrome tail |t|=m-n, yielding disjoint nonzero column supports, singular value r^(m+n) q^(ceil((m-n)/2)/2) of multiplicity q^n; adjoint handles m<n. The empty-word column norm diverges iff q r^4>=1, while counting j+1 splits per palindrome produces exact HS²=(1+2 q r²+q r^4)/(1-q r^4)² for smaller r. Length-diagonal gauge averaging forces necessity q r^(2p)<1 for S_p; absolute summation of block S_p norms gives sufficiency. At 1<p<2, r=q^(-1/(2p)), fixed signed length-offset bands have q^k copies of b_d q^(-k/p); summable b_d gives weak S_p bound through Ky-Fan inequalities, strong S_p ruled out by diagonal pinching. Independently generated word sets for q=2,3 and seven rectangular length pairs, numerically calculated singular spectra matching the multiplicity formula. Finite tests do not establish any infinite-dimensional endpoints.
